evidence.notes: Schema.DataCategory can be constructed locally as a passive describe value and exposes writable metadata fields.

source.content: @isTest private class SchemaDescribeMarkerTypesFixtureTest { @isTest static void touchesMarkerTypes() { Schema.DisplayType displayType = Schema.DisplayType.STRING; Schema.FieldDescribeOptions fieldOption = Schema.FieldDescribeOptions.DEFAULT; Schema.SOAPType soapType = Account.Name.getDescribe().getSOAPType(); Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions describeOption = Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions.DEFAULT; Schema.SObjectField fieldToken = Account.Name; Schema.SObjectType typeToken = Account.SObjectType; Object fieldMap = Account.SObjectType.getDescribe().fields; Object fieldSetMap = Account.SObjectType.getDescribe().fieldSets; Schema.DataCategory category = new Schema.DataCategory(); category.name = 'Hardware'; category.label = 'Hardware'; System.assertEquals('Hardware', category.getName()); System.assertEquals('Hardware', category.getLabel()); System.assertEquals(0, category.getChildCategories().size()); Schema.DataCategoryGroupSobjectTypePair pair = new Schema.DataCategoryGroupSobjectTypePair(); pair.setSobject('Knowledge__kav'); pair.setDataCategoryGroupName('Products'); List<Object> groups = Schema.describeDataCategoryGroups(new List<String>{'Knowledge__kav'}); List<Object> structures = Schema.describeDataCategoryGroupStructures(new List<Schema.DataCategoryGroupSobjectTypePair>{pair}, false); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.STRING, displayType); System.assertEquals(Schema.FieldDescribeOptions.DEFAULT, fieldOption); System.assertEquals(Schema.SOAPType.STRING, soapType); System.assertEquals(Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions.DEFAULT, describeOption); System.assertEquals('Name', fieldToken.getDescribe().getName()); System.assertEquals('Account', typeToken.getDescribe().getName()); System.assert(fieldMap != null); System.assert(fieldSetMap != null); System.assert(groups != null); System.assert(structures != null); } }
